test_include_copy_simple: test include_copy to merge a mixin into an MJCF model and verify compiler attributes are copied
test_include_copy_with_references: test include_copy to verify internal references like sensor site are updated to copied elements
test_include_copy_with_assets: test include_copy to verify meshes textures and hfields are copied with preserved file references
test_include_copy_conflict_detection: test include_copy raises ValueError when conflicting attribute values exist between model and mixin
test_include_copy_override_attributes: test include_copy with override_attributes=True to force overwrite conflicting compiler attributes from a mixin
